sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00, looking to extend their impressive run of form. Sandbach are in outstanding shape, sitting top with 22 points from 10 games and unbeaten in their last five outings (W-D-W-W-W). Alsager arrive as one of the division's struggling sides, currently bottom with just 4 points and on a poor run of five consecutive defeats, so the hosts will be heavy favourites to maintain their position at the summit.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a fixture with title-race implications; Stafford's recent draw suggests a slight dip in form, while Dawley have shown some resilience with a win in their last six. AFC Bridgnorth, third and in-form, host Eccleshall (sixth place) in an intriguing mid-table clash after Bridgnorth bounced back from their sole defeat with a recent win. Fourth-ranked Wolverhampton Casuals visit Wednesfield Community in a derby-style encounter between sides separated by just 6 points. Bilston Town (fifth) travel to face Foley Meir at home in a meeting of mid-table contenders. Market Drayton Town host New Mills; both teams are struggling with recent poor form and sit in the lower half. Brereton Social welcome Widnes Town—a fixture pitting a mid-table team against the division's rock-bottom side on just 2 points. Crewe entertain Allscott Heath in a lower-half fixture between two sides seeking consistency. Shawbury United host Barnton; Shawbury have lost their last five games while Barnton showed recent improvement with a win. Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in a battle between two of the division's lowest-ranked teams, both desperately needing points.
